stances_toward.note: Luhansk (99.6% occupied), Donetsk (78%), Zaporizhzhia (75%) and Kherson (72%) at the start of 2026 (DeepState); Russia proclaimed their annexation on 30 Sep 2022 and the General Assembly rejected it on 12 Oct 2022. The unoccupied rest of Donetsk (Sloviansk-Kramatorsk) is the sticking point: the Kremlin demands a Ukrainian withdrawal as the condition of peace, Kyiv refuses. Ukraine's map shows these oblasts as claimed, not controlled; the part still under Ukrainian control is own territory and is not drawn separately.

relations_to.summary: Ukraine claims Luhansk, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia and Kherson, proclaimed annexed by Russia on 30 Sep 2022; DeepState puts the occupied shares at 99.6%, 78%, 75% and 72% at the start of 2026. The Kremlin demands that Ukraine also withdraw from the part of Donetsk it holds.
